notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
